name: Netlify
one_liner: Netlify provides a REST API for managing sites, deploys, forms, DNS, and more.
auth_notes: To authenticate API requests, include the token in the authorization header: Authorization: Bearer <token>.
access_notes: To generate a personal access token (PAT): 1. Go to Applications > Personal access tokens. 2. Select New access token.

extras.rate_limits: You can make up to 500 requests per minute for most requests.

evidence.snippet: Use the Netlify REST API to manage atomic deploys of your sites and apps, manage form submissions, inject JavaScript snippets, manage DNS, and so much more.

[Netlify MCP Server](https://docs.netlify.com/welcome/build-with-ai/netlify-mcp-server/) follows the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.org) to enable code agents to use the Netlify API and CLI—so they can create new projects, build, deploy, and manage your Netlify resources using natural language prompts.
